test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What amount will be disbursed from FY 2020-21 to FY 2025-26 under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund established by the Central Government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) was launched by the Government of India to provide **medium to long-term debt financing** for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
 
• The scheme will disburse **₹1 lakh crore** from FY 2020-21 to FY 2025-26 for infrastructure development in the agriculture sector.
 
• The loans under the AIF will be provided with **3% interest subvention** and credit guarantee coverage for loans up to ₹2 crore.
 
• The fund aims to improve farmer income by reducing post-harvest losses and enabling better storage, processing, and marketing of agricultural produce.
 
• Eligible beneficiaries include **farmer producer organizations (FPOs), self-help groups (SHGs), PACs, startups, and agri-entrepreneurs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purpose of the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF):**

 
 
• The fund is focused on building post-harvest management infrastructure like warehouses, cold storages, and processing units to reduce wastage and improve supply chain efficiency.
 
• Additionally, it supports community farming assets such as custom hiring centers, primary processing units, and logistics facilities.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Framework:**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
 
• Funds are disbursed through lending institutions like scheduled commercial banks, cooperative banks, and regional rural banks (RRBs).
 
 
 
• **Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE):**
 
 
• Credit guarantees under the AIF are provided via CGTMSE, ensuring that small and medium-sized borrowers can access loans without collateral.
 
 
 
• **Key Objectives:**
 
 
• Reduce post-harvest losses, improve farmers' access to markets, and create employment opportunities in rural areas.
 
• Enhance agricultural productivity and ensure better price realization for farmers.
 
 
 
• **Monitoring and Evaluation:**
 
 
• The scheme's progress is monitored using the dedicated **AIF portal**, which tracks disbursements, project implementation, and outcomes.
 
• Beneficiaries can apply online through the portal for simplified and transparent processing.
 
 

89:T
